featured_reviews.name: Anjaneya Mhatre
featured_reviews.review_text:
I added two stars for the good owners. The guy present in the store is an extremely cranky and irritable person. Last year, I purchased a large beautiful seated Ganesha with led lighting and 5 brass Hindu idols. Gave them Rs.25k worth of business in one order. At the time of selling, the cranky man had said the metallic gold paint on the Ganesha's garments will not get tarnished. But it started turning black in just 6 months. When I visited him today, I showed him pictures of the blackened paint and asked him the remedy. I had not uttered the word guarantee or warranty, I simply and calmly asked him what's the solution. And he started rudely telling me in a loud voice that there is no warranty or guarantee for any items in the store. I again asked him what's the solution and I understand there's nothing like a warranty for the art items. But he should offer a solution since he had claimed the paint will not fade or get tarnished. He again started almost shouting that I will never give warranty or guarantee. If you want to get it repainted, you have to pay the artists fees. I said ok what would be the approximate fees. Again screamed, How will I know? Artist is not available now. When he will be back, you have to pay whatever he asks for. And he did this ruckus in front of other customers in the shop potentially jeopardizing future sales.

I told him I will not shop there again left the store as I didn't want to traumatize my daughter who was with me. Even as we were leaving, the guy said, your choice don't come here again.

Apart from this negative experience with the cranky man, the store has beautiful artworks and the owners are decent people. Last year, they delivered the Ganesha to our home carefully so that we don't need to worry about damaging it while taking it home. So two stars to the owners. But zero for the cranky store guy.

featured_reviews.name: Nikhil Jawrani
featured_reviews.review_text: One of the original greeting card store to have existed in the BKS area. Remember visiting here since my college days back in the early 2000s. They have excellent collection of greeting cards and gifting items for all occasions. Their home decor collection is also very good. Once your enter, you are bound to pick up something even if you did not plan to.

featured_reviews.name: Bhupesh Toraskar
featured_reviews.review_text: So fabulous place I took some gifts from here yesterday 😊

featured_reviews.name: Nikhil Panchal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst store of Archies with pathetic service

There is no value for customers' feelings here.

I arrived at the store at 9:45 PM, and despite all the staff being inside, the counter person immediately refused to assist me, stating that the shop was closed and they couldn't do anything. Even after I requested, he still denied any help. All the other staff members saw me, yet no one even attempted to assist.

It was one of my best friend's birthdays the next day, and after being late from work, my last hope was Archies. Unfortunately, it turned out to be the worst experience ever. I was left feeling helpless, and despite my requests, the counter person was unyielding.

This was by far the worst store experience I've had with Archies, featuring absolutely pathetic service.

featured_reviews.name: Sobin Benny
featured_reviews.review_text: Worst store of Archies, full of attitude people.

featured_reviews.name: Sangita Tandon
featured_reviews.review_text: I love Archies. It's my favourite place when I want to pick up a gift, a greeting card or an artifact for young and old alike. The place is so inviting and warm. It has such a large variety of articles from soft toys to reclining Buddha statue. And it has both a blend of traditional as well as modern stuff. My favourite are customized mugs available for any occasion, even to express ones feelings, like a Big Thank you or wishes for an achievement. I end up picking more than I go for even cute titbits too.i love Archies.

featured_reviews.name: Narendra Mehra
featured_reviews.review_text: Standard Archies Gallery situated on main Swami Vivekanand road in Santa Cruz west. Usual gift and toys. Cards. And such other items found in Archies. The location is very good. However parking is an issue. Especially with the infrastructure work going on on Swami Vivekanand road and nearby areas. The shop is well stocked. Good staff and layout.

Go here for buying gifts and gift yourself a thing or two if you love your handicrafts

featured_reviews.name: Zee Brew
featured_reviews.review_text: Absolutely loved these coffee glasses from Pebble Life! They look beautiful, feel sturdy, and instantly make every coffee look even better. The customized coasters were such a thoughtful touch too. Great quality and aesthetics, definitely recommend!

featured_reviews.name: Anuridhi Arya
featured_reviews.review_text: I love my recent purchase from Pebel. I wasn’t sure at first of the quality so I had only ordered a single piece. I loved the simplicity of it so much that I eventually bought 4 more. They’re great for everyday use and are surprisingly durable too. Would recommend them to anyone looking for a clean aesthetic.

featured_reviews.name: Maulik Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text: Loved the bag from Pebel Lifeware! The quality and finish are excellent, and the custom name looks so neatly printed—it feels like a part of the bag itself. Super quick delivery was a bonus. Highly recommend!

Also the naming customisation doesn’t look like how it’s shown in the image. It’s just etched on the silicone cover unlike in image where it’s different

featured_reviews.name: Nikkhhil Thackar
featured_reviews.review_text: I am glad that I ordered Diwali gifts for my team members and loved once from Pebel. Their products are really awesome and they have curated Diwali gifts really well. Not just that they are very much open for any modifications and give you the unique experience through customisation. I like the overall communication and service.

featured_reviews.name: Juli
featured_reviews.review_text: After placing the order for two Signature bottles, I emailed Pebel Team for additional customization. They quicky connected with me and took the details. Frankly dint expect how beautiful they turned out. Both my daughter are obsessed with them! Thank you Pebel team.

featured_reviews.name: Shaik Azgar
featured_reviews.review_text: We ordered these bottles from the Pebel team as year-end giveaway goodies for our clients, and the quality exceeded our expectations. The bottles are premium, well-designed, and feel truly top quality. We placed a bulk order, which was delivered on time, and our clients were very pleased with both the quality and the design. Highly recommend Pebel for corporate gifting. #IceManIndia

featured_reviews.name: Manisha Vagh
featured_reviews.review_text: I gifted these personalized mugs from the Pebel Lifeware to my husband on my anniversary along with some other gifts. He got very happy and excited to see such a lovely personalised thing inside. Its very beautiful and have a perfectly carved names on mugs and photoframe which is so minimal.. highly recommended product..
